api.Config: Config(cadence_s=60, n_candidates=32, wm_samples=8, horizon_s=600, p_star=0.8). Samples must be >=2; unregistered or shortened horizons are refused.
api.score_moves: score_moves(record, rng, *, rollout, calibration, config=None, calibrate=None, move_api=None) -> dict. Shared simulator-independent scoring API for dense teachers.
api.observation: record has ego_id, group, rows, time_s, commands, policy_residuals, policy_state; optional history, world_id, state_id, committed_offsets, policy_radio. Sensor rows/history are whitelisted, causal and ego-local. Group includes ego and 1..4 observed CAVs.
api.policy_radio: Required for V2V actors: frame (time_s and whitelisted observable rows plus causally sensed acceleration), previous_commands, deterministic, noise, generator_state, log_std, intent. Runtime snapshots retain only already-observed rows/CAV histories. intent is null or includes horizon, prior timestamped board, learned head weight/bias and bounds. Missing V2V/intent state, noncausal publications, extra fields or out-of-view identities fail closed.
api.moves_dependency: Lazy import tools.coopmwm.moves; calls candidates(obs_state, rng, n), offsets(move, t) and FAMILIES. Members must be drawn from record['group']. No production stub.
api.calibration_dependency: Lazy import tools.coopmwm.planner_calibration.calibrate_probability(p_raw, calibration) -> probability in [0,1], or explicit calibrate adapter. Calibration is mandatory; no identity/raw fallback.
api.rollout: Callable(record, actions, K, H) -> {action_id: K paired scalar costs or dicts containing team_delay}. Uses common future indices; lower cost is better.
api.WMRollout: WMRollout(runtime, memory=None, chunk_actions=4) checks CPU model/policy parameters and calls plan_wm.evaluate with trim=False, final_chain=True, require_policy_radio=True and full H. Reuses existing WM/source/safety/ownership machinery.
api.Continuation: planner_policy.Continuation(record, policy=None). residuals(state, ids, tick) uses the live encode/widen/V2V feature builders and learned actor. At tick zero each branch resets to the captured state and reuses the live sampled residual; later whole-second decisions advance that branch's policy/noise/intent state. observe_issued(state, command, tick) receives post-safety ownership-issued commands. All none/candidate branches retain their own causal history after offsets end.
api.legacy_compatibility: plan_wm.evaluate adds require_policy_radio=False and plan_executor adds policy_radio=None. Existing callers retain their prior behavior when these are absent. policy_wm.py is unchanged; the online planner explicitly bypasses its legacy zero-filled-partner approximation.
api.selection: Explicit none id='policy' continues the current base actor. p_raw is the fraction of strictly positive paired gains; ties do not win. Apply calibration, then select greatest positive expected gain meeting calibrated P >= p_star, with stable ties. Returns selected_move/id, execution offset_profile, scores, paired gains, full horizon and gate receipt.
api.OnlinePlanner: OnlinePlanner(*, rollout, calibration, rng, accel_bounds, config=None, calibrate=None, move_api=None, world_id=None). Dedicated move RNG; inherited acceleration bounds with upper bound <=1.2. apply(..., sample, desired, policy, policy_radio=None) returns the single pre-safety request map.
api.runtime_hook: v2v_runtime.controller_class(acceleration.Controller)(policy, generator, deterministic, planner_online=planner). None/omission is OFF. Concurrent guide/replay/branch producers are refused. Enabled runtime captures pre-step observable radio/intent state automatically.
api.execution: Every cadence re-evaluates disjoint ego-local groups and replaces old moves. Failed/rejected gates return that group to base immediately. Between decisions offsets run to their end; lost members/radio contact release the joint move. Every forecast remains 600 seconds. Other locally visible commitments are the same background in both arms.
api.single_writer: Only modifies the pre-safety request map and sample action record; own_action remains the sampled base action. Never writes TraCI. Existing CommandOwnership remains the sole plant writer with safe speedMode 27. No HDV command recipients.
api.events: Enabled sample['planner_online'] records decisions, paired scores, calibrated probabilities, failures, executed offsets and active group count. event['requests'] is final. Disabled events and policy RNG remain identical to track-base. Actor loading for radio forecasts also preserves global torch RNG.
